plan.study: Native RAM-backed-device materialization sensitivity; unchanged product C

host_configuration.storage: new owned RAM-backed null_blk service models; native host status does not establish physical NVMe fidelity

plan.hypothesis: Full backing-page writes before setup reduce first-touch null_blk allocation in swapz append traffic more than in the bounded raw working set; measure model sensitivity without treating it as a product gain.

states.F: Fresh newly owned devices, canonical setup/warmup only
states.M: Both newly owned raw and swapz backing receive a full 64MiB direct zero write before any target setup, with exact lower-sector completion checks

plan.raw_target_order: raw-first odd rounds, swapz-first even rounds, same in both condition blocks

primary_family.endpoint: Per round, difference of mean log(swapz useful WRITE / own raw WRITE) in M and F; two repeats averaged within each block before pairing
primary_family.sign_test: Exact two-sided sign tests, adjusted p=min(1,3*p)
primary_family.interpretation: Condition sensitivity only; a direction requires family interval excluding zero, adjusted sign p<0.05, absolute point effect >=5% and >=7 usable rounds. No equivalence or product optimization claim.

exclusions: Exclude both condition blocks for a scenario/round if either repetition has ERROR, NOISY, UNKNOWN, missing/incorrect ownership or materialization marker, source/input/CPU geometry mismatch
Within-condition repeat raw WRITE max/min spread >10% excludes both conditions for that scenario/round; fast_test retains and labels all data
Cross-condition raw rate differences are outcomes and are NOT screened as host drift
No replacement samples, adaptive extension or pooling with earlier experiments
plan.secondary: Absolute raw/swapz useful READ/WRITE, READ/WRITE p95/p99, independent lower bytes/requests, GC and process/host resources; pointwise descriptive 95% paired intervals. Do not sum overlapping timers into CPU.
plan.history_boundary: No canonical make test protocol changes or qualified history points. All devices remain newly created/owned; no swap or physical backing.
plan.entry_preflight: Fixed two-second startup settling followed by three standard quiet windows before first observation
plan.pre_sample_correction: First study attempt completed F block only; M stopped in native preflight before device creation because its environment leaked materialization into a linear-calibration argument contract. First attempt preserved separately, no paired effect examined or reused. Corrected protocol isolates calibration before the fixed restart.

scope: Unchanged-C host/model sensitivity, not product improvement or physical media evidence; no cross-condition raw drift exclusion. Paired t/sign assumptions and chronological dependence remain limits.
disposition: Model sensitivity suggestive on persistent NVMe5 but no primary passes all declared direction criteria. No product change, equivalence or physical-media claim. No added samples; canonical fresh-device protocol retained.
resource_scope: Materialization writes 128MiB total data region per pair before setup/timing, on two new owned devices. Extra residency/metadata/allocator rounding and total CPU not measured; native RSS excludes kernel pages.
